_status: CONCEPT / DRAFT - NOT loaded by ValueModel or engine.py. See Docs/DEFAULT_VALUES_AND_COLOR_PIE_v1.md for methodology and sources.

_data_sources.color_pie_classification: https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/making-magic/mechanical-color-pie-2021 (official WotC design document - primary/secondary/tertiary per color per mechanic)
_data_sources.root_reference_cards: Own MTG knowledge, not live-verified against Scryfall this session (same limitation as the red pilot).

loot.root_card: standard loot template: discard 1, draw 2, 2 mana

boardwipe.root_card: Wrath of God {2}{W}{W}: destroy all creatures

ramp.root_card: Rampant Growth {1}{G}: 1 permanent mana from next turn on

mill.confidence: low - no stable, widely-recognized root reference card found; placeholder pending discussion

color_pie_multipliers._scale: 1.0 = at the category's root/best-in-class rate (the color WotC lists as primary for that mechanic). Values sourced from magic.wizards.com/en/news/making-magic/mechanical-color-pie-2021.
color_pie_multipliers._note_red_interaction: Red is NOT primary for 'destroy' removal but IS primary for damage-based removal (a different mechanic). The 0.70 multiplier reflects that Red gets there a different way, not that it is generically weak - consistent with the red pilot's Lightning Bolt finding (3.0 effect points/mana, above the category root).

resource_to_mana_conversion._status: IMPLEMENTED as of v4.15.4 (value-estimation utilities only - see Data/Models/goldfish_value_model.json::resource_to_mana_conversion and ValueModel.life_as_mana_equivalent/delve_mana_equivalent/convoke_improvise_mana_equivalent/sacrifice_cost_equivalent/stun_counter_value_multiplier/stun_counter_mana_equivalent_fallback/uptime_value_discount in App/engine.py). NOT wired into the real cast/payment path (available_mana_value) - that remains a separate, larger, not-yet-built feature. Converts alternative resources paid as costs into the same mana_unit currency already used throughout goldfish_value_model.json, so downside-gated cards become comparable without a blanket multiplier. (Contrast: the DIFFERENT self-scaling-condition gap boardwipe_effective_cost_estimate used to flag as open - 'costs {N} less for each creature you control'-shaped text - WAS wired into the real payment path in v4.15.5 via the new module-level boardwipe_self_scaling_discount function called from cast_option; this resource_to_mana_conversion section is not affected by that and remains estimate-only.)
resource_to_mana_conversion._taxonomy: Two buckets: (A) additional/alternative CASTING costs - a resource is actually spent to reduce/replace mana; (B) built-in DOWNSIDES of the resulting permanent/effect - no resource is spent, but usability is restricted. Life/Delve/Convoke/Emerge/Discard/Echo are bucket A. Stun counters/Suspend/Decayed/conditional attack-block restrictions are bucket B.

delve.source: Official WotC keyword templating: exiling a card from graveyard pays for exactly {1} generic mana (Treasure Cruise, Dig Through Time, Tasigur, the Golden Fang).

convoke_improvise.source: Official WotC keyword templating: tapping an untapped creature (Convoke) or artifact (Improvise) pays for {1} generic mana (Convoke additionally allows paying colored mana of the creature's color).

emerge_validates_sacrifice_lookup.note: Emerge's own reminder text defines its cost reduction as exactly the mana value of the exiled creature - this is official confirmation that the dynamic-lookup approach already proposed for sacrifice_as_cost (rather than a flat constant) is the right model, not a new rate to add.

discard_as_cost.note: No single official numeric conversion exists (unlike delve/convoke). Reuse the existing discard_self=-1.2 knob already in goldfish_value_model.json rather than inventing a new constant.

echo.status: cataloged only, not worked out in detail

suspend.method: same percentage-of-value discount approach as stun counters, scaled by the length of the delay
suspend.status: no new mechanism needed - same modeling as stun_counter_as_cost

decayed.method: value the creature as a single attack's worth of impact rather than ongoing board presence (it is sacrificed after attacking and cannot block)
decayed.status: same bucket-B usage-limited-duration logic, no new formula needed

bucket_b_builtin_downsides.explicitly_out_of_scope: Energy counters and planeswalker loyalty are separate resource systems entirely (not mana-alternatives) - deliberately excluded, noted so it's clear they were considered, not missed.

life_as_cost.source: Official WotC design rate, derived from Phyrexian mana templating (New Phyrexia, {C/P} symbols): pay 1 colored mana OR pay 2 life. 2 life = 1 mana.
life_as_cost.cross_check: Existing goldfish_value_model.json life_gain_per_point=0.667 is the same order of magnitude as this cost-side rate (0.5) - consistent, not contradictory; treated as a mild validation of the existing knob rather than a reason to change it.

sacrifice_as_cost.formula: cost_equivalent = ValueModel.aggregate_value(...) of the specific sacrificed permanent, not a flat constant
sacrifice_as_cost.note: Conceptually the same idea as the existing discard_self=-1.2 knob (an abstract card-resource cost), but sacrifice should ideally use the actual value of the specific card sacrificed rather than a flat penalty, since a 1-mana token and a fully-built bomb are not equivalent sacrifices.

stun_counter_as_cost.confidence: low - no official WotC conversion rate exists for this (unlike life/Phyrexian mana)
stun_counter_as_cost.preferred_method: percentage discount on the affected permanent's own value, rather than a flat mana amount, because delaying a strong bomb is worse than delaying a small mana dork
stun_counter_as_cost.fallback_method: flat rate above, only if the permanent's own value is not yet known at evaluation time

conditional_restrictions.example: can attack only if you control a legendary creature
conditional_restrictions.method: NOT a resource conversion - no currency changes hands, so folding this into mana-equivalents would be a category error
conditional_restrictions.preferred_method: uptime probability discount - estimate the fraction of games in which the condition is met, multiply the stat's usable value by that fraction

open_questions_not_implemented.example: legendary creature-land, 4 mana, 8/8, enters with stun counters, cannot attack until counters removed
open_questions_not_implemented.status: partially refined via resource_to_mana_conversion above (life/sacrifice/stun-counter now have a concrete conversion approach); conditional restrictions (can't-attack-unless clauses) are explicitly out of scope for mana-conversion and still need an uptime-probability model - not designed in detail, not implemented

open_questions_not_implemented.idea: blend the predefined static ValueModel score with an observed average net_value contribution per card across real simulation runs (card_impact.csv already tracks per-card data per run)
open_questions_not_implemented.status: NOT implemented - would need new cross-run tracking/aggregation logic, not just a JSON table; flagged as a distinct future work package
